Context: 9. Benefits to the families of Government servants who go missing during service

When a Government servant goes missing, the benefits of family pension may be paid to the family if he had exercised option for benefits under CCS (Pension) Rules on death or discharge from service on disability I invalidation. The benefit of arrears of salary, retirement gratuity and leave encashment shall be paid to the family in all cases where a Government employee covered under NPS goes missing during service, irrespective of whether the employee had exercised option for benefits under CCS (Pension)
